inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein’s talk of a “political resolution” sounds less like a path to peace than an attempt to manage the public story while Israel’s operation continues. The insistence that Iran’s nuclear and missile programs are the issue gives the ongoing campaign a ready-made justification; the real priority may be preserving leverage, not resolving the conflict.

Preserving leverage rather than resolving the conflict
